description: internal/version: the linker-stamped build identity. Small, but it is the output an operator pastes into a bug report and the one a release script greps, and it was the last package with logic and no set.

mutants.old: return fmt.Sprintf("plock %s (commit %s, built %s)", Version, Commit, Date)
mutants.new: return fmt.Sprintf("plock %s (built %s, commit %s)", Version, Date, Commit)
mutants.note: the label order is the documented output contract of `plock version`, and the doc comment claims a test pins it -- this mutant is that claim being checked rather than believed

the empty-by-default rule is what makes a bare `go build` report something honest. An empty version prints as "plock  (commit none, built unknown)", which a release script grepping for a version string reads as a version that exists
